scientific_integrity: The theorem for every integer \(n\ge3\) follows from a symbolic classification of all rowmotion cycles; complete computation for \(3\le n\le6\) and sampling for larger \(n\) are corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: The assertion concerns the rank-one/rank-two Boolean subposet and classical combinatorial rowmotion only.
Equivalence to an unindexed earlier theorem remains a priority risk; no independent scholarly review has been performed.
title: Uniformly bounded rowmotion on the first two nonempty Boolean ranks
